performance.verdict: 9 overdue SOW milestones block attribution; ad efficiency secondary until stack is live.

findings.text: 5 milestones were due 2026-07-31 (stack test, GHL migration, GBP triage, Meta CAPI, landing pages) — all remain incomplete 57 days overdue.
3 milestones due Aug 31–Sep 1 (Meta reactivation lanes, Search campaigns, LSA submission, nurture sequences) also undelivered as of today 2026-09-25.
CPL rose 10% to ~$5.23 as spend surged 230%; 3-day signal (Sep 22–24): $68/$58/$39 spend, 20/14/7 leads — CPL worsening as campaign scales, not improving.
GBP actions fell 36.84% week-over-week while Meta spend tripled; 77 GBP actions over 28 days with 0 in the last 3 days — organic engagement collapsing in parallel.
GA4 shows 0 conversions across 3,411 sessions and GHL pipeline is null — leads arriving via Meta but zero pipeline evidence; intake or tracking is broken, not an ads problem.

suggestions.text: Escalate all 9 overdue SOW milestones to Nacer immediately; no further budget increases until stack test and tracking are verified.
suggestions.monday_update: 9 SOW milestones are overdue between 57 and 24 days, including the end-to-end stack test, GHL migration, Meta CAPI, and landing pages. With 3,411 GA4 sessions and 0 conversions recorded, and GHL pipeline returning null, there is no confirmed path from Meta lead to booked appointment. Escalate to Nacer for immediate gate review; success is confirmed stack test completion and at least one lead visible in GHL pipeline. Re-check by 2026-09-30.

suggestions.text: Watch MDST-WES-AWARE-WHTAPP CPL over next 3 days; hold spend flat until milestone gates clear.
suggestions.monday_update: The top campaign (MDST-WES-AWARE-WHTAPP, $331.64 of $497.27 28-day spend) produced a 10% CPL rise alongside the 230% spend surge. The 3-day trend shows leads dropping from 20 to 7 as spend held above $39/day, signalling efficiency decay. Hold daily spend at current ~$43/day and re-check CPL on 2026-09-28; if CPL exceeds $7.00 over that window, flag for budget reduction.

suggestions.text: Audit GA4 conversion events and GHL lead intake; 95 Meta leads and 0 pipeline entries confirm a tracking or intake break.
suggestions.monday_update: 95 Meta leads were recorded over 28 days but GA4 shows 0 conversions across 3,411 sessions and GHL pipeline returns null. This is either a missing conversion event on the landing page or a broken GHL intake connection — both are listed as overdue SOW deliverables from 2026-07-31. Assign to the Web/CRM team to verify the lead-to-pipeline path; success is confirmed when at least 1 inbound lead appears as an opportunity in GHL. Target resolution by 2026-09-30.
